 FBI: Man arrested in Germany, accused of orchestrating Fort Wayne teen’s suicide over Discord 
 “Anyone who targets or exploits a child should understand this: There is no safe haven from justice.” 
 By Jazlynn Bebout Published : Oct. 23, 2026 at 3:19 PM EDT | Updated : 3 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google INDIANAPOLIS (WPTA) - The FBI Indianapolis Field Office says an 18-year-old German man has been arrested on a count of murder in a Fort Wayne teen’s death. 
 The Fort Wayne Police Department says officers responded to a death investigation involving a 14-year-old girl earlier this month. 
 FWPD’s Homicide Unit identified a suspect who contributed to her death, working with the FBI and authorities in Germany. 
 The FBI says German authorities recently arrested an 18-year-old man on suspicion of murder in the girl’s death. 
 According to a translated article by NDR , a German television broadcaster, the Hamburg Public Prosecutor’s Office said the unnamed suspect was 17 at the time of the crime. 
 EDITOR’S NOTE: Details in the NDR article are graphic. Viewer discretion is advised. 
 The prosecutor’s office says the suspect communicated with the girl over Discord, manipulating her into hurting herself and ultimately taking her own life. 
 NDR reports that the suspect, a resident of Hamburg, Germany, allegedly demanded that the girl record her self-harm. After the girl died, prosecutors say he allegedly tried to obtain recordings of the girl’s suicide. 
 Investigators say he is believed to have orchestrated her suicide, NDR reports, threatening that he would release compromising video of her. 
 The article says police also found that the girl made references to the group “NMK” (Nefarious Maniac Cult) in her recordings.
 The Fort Wayne Police Department recently warned the community about similar dark web groups . 
 On Oct. 14, FWPD held a press conference to warn parents, guardians, educators, and young people about such online networks that they say are leading to deaths across the country.
 They say the perpetrators reportedly use Discord, Roblox, Telegram, and other online platforms to build relationships with children and other vulnerable individuals.
 They say messages and friend requests from such predators can escalate to grooming, sextortion, threats, and psychological manipulation. Information and photos victims send can then be used by the groups to manipulate, threaten, blackmail, or extort children.
 “Anyone who targets or exploits a child should understand this: There is no safe haven from justice. It doesn’t matter where you live or where you try to hide. 
 The FBI will work with our partners around the world to find you and hold you accountable. When children are victimized, we will pursue every lead and use every available resource. Wherever you go, justice will find you.”
 FBI Indianapolis Special Agent in Charge Timothy J. O’Malley said. The FBI says information about potential federal crimes can be reported here .
